nidoran-f-roar.name: Roar
nidoran-f-roar.description: Bond skill: a fearsome roar pushes every adjacent foe back 1 hex.

nidoran-f-gunk-shot.name: Gunk Shot
nidoran-f-gunk-shot.description: Bond skill: hurls a heap of filth at an adjacent foe (Power 100, Attack).

nidoran-f-sludge-wave.name: Sludge Wave
nidoran-f-sludge-wave.description: Bond skill: a wave of sludge hits all foes within 2 hexes (Power 75, Sp. Atk), Poisoning for 1 turn.

nidoran-f-hustle.name: Hustle
nidoran-f-hustle.description: Deals 15% more damage, but its free strikes deal 25% less.

nidoran-f-poison-point.name: Poison Point
nidoran-f-poison-point.description: Its damaging hits on adjacent foes Poison them for 1 turn.

nidoran-f-fury-swipes.name: Fury Swipes
nidoran-f-fury-swipes.description: New skill: a flurry of quick scratches (Power 45).

nidoran-f-acid.name: Acid
nidoran-f-acid.description: New skill: sprays acid at a foe up to 2 hexes away (Power 40), leaving it Marked for 2 turns.

nidoran-f-armored-scales.name: Armored Scales
nidoran-f-armored-scales.description: Its hard, needle-studded scales: takes 10% less damage.

nidoran-f-venom-expertise.name: Venom Expertise
nidoran-f-venom-expertise.description: Deals 20% more damage to Poisoned foes.

nidoran-f-sludge.name: Sludge
nidoran-f-sludge.description: New skill: hurls toxic sludge up to 2 hexes away (Power 60), Poisoning the foe for 2 turns.

nidoran-f-crunch.name: Crunch
nidoran-f-crunch.description: New skill: bites down hard (Power 80), leaving the foe Exposed for 1 turn.

nidoran-f-mud-shot.name: Mud Shot
nidoran-f-mud-shot.description: New skill: hurls mud at a foe up to 2 hexes away (Power 75) that Slows it for 1 turn.

nidoran-f-sheer-force.name: Sheer Force
nidoran-f-sheer-force.description: Its Ground-type moves deal 20% more damage.

nidoran-f-queens-resolve.name: Queen's Resolve
nidoran-f-queens-resolve.description: Survives one knockout blow per battle at 1 HP.

nidoran-f-earth-power.name: Earth Power
nidoran-f-earth-power.description: New skill: the ground erupts under a foe up to 2 hexes away (Power 90).

nidoran-f-stomping-tantrum.name: Stomping Tantrum
nidoran-f-stomping-tantrum.description: New skill: stomps furiously, hitting all adjacent foes (Power 85).

nidoran-f-matriarch.name: Matriarch
nidoran-f-matriarch.description: Gives the team 1 Bond whenever it lands a combo.

nidoran-f-mothers-watch.name: Mother's Watch
nidoran-f-mothers-watch.description: Foes engaged with it take 10% more damage from its allies.

nidoran-f-iron-queen.name: Iron Queen
nidoran-f-iron-queen.description: Capstone. Takes 15% less damage; foes it pushes into an obstacle take 15 extra damage.

nidoran-f-toxic-queen.name: Toxic Queen
nidoran-f-toxic-queen.description: Capstone. When a foe it afflicted faints, adjacent foes catch that status; each knockout gives 1 Bond.

nidoran-f-thick-hide.name: Thick Hide
nidoran-f-thick-hide.description: Its thick hide: takes 20% less damage while at full HP.

nidoran-f-queens-wrath.name: Queen's Wrath
nidoran-f-queens-wrath.description: Deals 20% more damage while 2+ foes stand next to it.

nidoran-f-growl.name: Growl
nidoran-f-growl.description: New skill: a sweet growl leaves an adjacent foe Weakened for 2 turns.
